other_conditions: Applicant must be suffering from an illness or require surgery
Applicants already receiving financial assistance from other government schemes are ineligible
Applicant must hold one of the following ration cards: Priority Household Ration Card (PHH), Antyodaya Ration Card, or Green Card
benefits_summary: Provides cash assistance ranging from ₹1,500 to ₹25,000 depending on illness type, treatment duration, and whether the beneficiary is an adult or minor.
